/pioneer-laseractive-pac-s1-eprom-bios-d: A Pioneer LaserActive PAC-S1 yields a socketed Fujitsu EPROM and some curious BIOS data. Inconsistent GQ-4X reads make the preservation job less simple. 💾
/sega-master-system-converter-ii-pull-ap: One thousand subscribers! Time to dismantle a Sega Master System Converter II, including its Model 2 spacer, Pause button and surprising lack of circuitry. 🎮
/subscribe-today-version-30/: RetroJunkie channel trailer 3.0 advertises old hardware videos and the McRetro Gaming sister channel. Apparently the backlog of retro madness never ends. 📺
/teenage-engineering-op-1-synthesiser-de: A Teenage Engineering OP-1 synthesiser makes lovely music, but sadly it belongs to somebody else. One can dream while the video backlog clears. 🎹
/console-collection-overview-december-20: A December 2013 tour of my console collection reveals TeraDrives, three Sophias, Aiwa Mega-CDs and too many shelves. Downsizing is apparently a relative term. 🎮
/rubbish-collection-finds-december-2013/: Council rubbish collection delivers a floppy disk box, Nintendo AV cable and a very heavy speaker. Not all the roadside electronics are worth repairing. 🖥️
/moving-house/: Moving house with a mountain of retro hardware means mystery boxes, packed-away consoles and drawers full of cables instead of clothes. Priorities! 📦
/playstation-2-8mb-memory-card-disassemb: An 8 MB PlayStation 2 memory card gets opened for a look at the tiny PCB inside. The iPhone can zoom, but focusing is apparently a different story. 💾
/sega-mega-drive-ii-clock/: An old Mega Drive II becomes a wall clock with misplaced drill holes, Blu Tack and some questionable engineering. At least it has Blast Processing! ⏰
/extreme-plays-snow-bros-nes-1991/: Snow Bros. on the NES brings arcade snowball action to Extreme Plays. Toaplan's frosty classic makes for a welcome change from repair disasters. ❄️
/mcretro-gaming-teaser-trailer/: McRetro Gaming launches as the spiritual successor to Xtreme Retro Gaming, with classic games, questionable skills and lots of videos still to come. 🎮
/subscribe-today-retro-gaming-is-fun/: McRetro Gaming's early channel trailer promises retro gameplay videos by the bucketful. Subscribe for the old consoles, stay for the inevitable chaos! 🎮
/the-lxr-drum-synthesizer-by-sonic-potio: SuperNick's Sonic Potions LXR drum synth has six voices, a sequencer and a ridiculous amount of soldering. I'm mostly here for the clap sounds. 🥁
/extreme-plays-dead-angle-sms-1989/: Dead Angle on the Sega Master System turns a 1988 arcade shooter into a 1989 control-pad adventure. No Light Phaser required for this thriller. 🎮
/nes-disassembly-mattel-version/: An Australian Mattel PAL-A NES gives up its metal shielding, unusual cartridge loader and secrets for a thorough teardown. Nintendo loves screws. 🔧
/nes-cartridge-slot-cleaning-mattel-vers: The Mattel NES cartridge connector gets a clean with isopropyl and a cloth-wrapped card. Dirty contacts are suspect, but the recap is still ahead. 🎮
/nes-mainboard-capacitor-replacement-mat: Three NES mainboard electrolytics are replaced, but the console still shows white screens. A new cartridge connector and proper 2.2 uF part are on order. 🔧
/subscribe-today-mcretro-wants-you/: RetroJunkie wants you! Another vintage channel trailer advertises McRetro Gaming, old electronics and more video madness than anyone reasonably needs. 📺
/sega-saturn-sophia-dev-kit-no-video-rep: A European Sega Saturn Sophia has no video despite signs of life. Capacitor work and switch tests bring progress, though another kit still needs attention. 🔧

/sony-dtl-h2000-playstation-development-: A Sony DTL-H2000 PlayStation ISA development-board EPROM comes in for a BIOS dump. GQ-4X device settings and inconsistent reads complicate preservation. 💾
/extreme-plays-spelunker-nes-1985/: Spelunker takes Extreme Plays back to the NES, via a 1983 computer game and its 1985 Japanese Famicom port. Time for some questionable cave exploration! 🎮
/common-ringtail-possums-feeding/: Common Ringtail Possums visit a Sydney balcony at 6 pm in winter, eating away like little furry rats. They're marsupials, though, not rodents! 🐾
/psio-prototype-11-test-station-setup-ov: A March 2014 PSIO 1.1 setup gets revisited: PAL SCPH-5502, XRGB-mini, microSD and a virtualised PC loader. Plenty more games to put through their paces. 🎮

/psio-prototype-11-game-demo-gran-turism: Gran Turismo 2's Simulation disc refuses to boot on PSIO 1.1, while Arcade barely gets further. The original Gran Turismo doesn't fare much better. 🏎️
/aiwa-mega-cd-csd-gm1-capacitor-values/: An Aiwa Mega-CD CSD-GM1 capacitor spreadsheet records values from two mainboard revisions. Handy for repairs, but not a definitive factory parts list. 🔧
/psio-prototype-11-game-demo-grandia/: Grandia gets its opening FMV running on PSIO 1.1 without sound, then locks into repeated dialogue. Another RPG that's tantalisingly close to playable. 🎮
/cancelled-channel-xtreme-retro-gaming/: Old Xtreme Retro Gaming footage resurfaces, including plans that eventually became McRetro Gaming. Some channel ideas live on even after cancellation. 🎮
/psio-prototype-11-game-demo-mega-man-le: Mega Man Legends 1 and 2 won't load on PSIO 1.1, while Philosoma makes it a little further before faltering. Three more games for the compatibility list. 🎮
/psio-prototype-11-game-demo-ridge-racer: Ridge Racer and Ridge Racer Revolution race along on PSIO 1.1, missing their background music. The cars still bounce off walls like pinballs, at least. 🏁
/psio-prototype-11-game-demo-soul-edge-s: Soul Edge, also known as Soul Blade, plays nicely through PSIO 1.1 with working combat and effects. Missing background music doesn't stop the sword fights. ⚔️
/psio-prototype-11-game-demo-wipeout-wip: Wipeout, Wipeout 2097 and Wip3out take turns stalling on PSIO 1.1. Silent opening videos and black screens make for a less-than-speedy racing session. 🏎️
/thoughts-on-psio-2x-recent-updates/: PSIO 2.x development reports claim working CDDA and XA audio and roughly 81% progress. Exciting news, but these are developer updates, not my own hardware tests. 🎮
/newly-hatched-willie-wagtail-chicks/: Newly hatched Willie Wagtails are adorable, but their swooping parents make the backyard a no-go zone. The family eventually moves on. 🐦
/the-2015-nix-mcretro-update/: 2015 arrives with study plans, a smaller retro collection and the end of RetroJunkie.net. Where's that Back to the Future hoverboard, Mattel? 🎮
/pioneer-laseractive-sega-pac-s1-disasse: The Pioneer LaserActive PAC-S1 comes apart to reveal Mega Drive and Mega-CD hardware covered in ageing capacitors. More than seventy replacements may be ahead. 🔧
/pioneer-laseractive-sega-pac-s1-mainboa: All the old electrolytics come off a Pioneer LaserActive PAC-S1 mainboard, with obvious leakage under one. Removal is done; replacement still lies ahead. 🔧
/pioneer-laseractive-sega-pac-s1-subboar: Roughly forty capacitors on the LaserActive PAC-S1 subboard should be easy to remove. Several lifted pads later, this board has other ideas. 🔧
/ants-nesting-in-an-apple-imac-g3/: An iMac G3 with a dead analogue board develops an even worse problem: hundreds of ants nesting inside! The little tenants move out before recycling. 🐜
/baby-willie-wagtail-call-vs-parent-call: A young Willie Wagtail and its parent provide a charming comparison of bird calls. The backyard family's youngster has already flown away. 🐦
/sega-genesis-activator-disassembly/: Inside the Sega Genesis Activator: infrared sensors, an 80C51-family controller, a 7805 regulator and plenty of wires. Gaming with your whole body was a choice. 🎮
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-pcb-arrival-part-1/: Purple OSH Park boards arrive for the Lunchbeat groovebox and PICkit 2 clone. Even the anime mascot made it onto the silkscreen. Parts still on order. 💜
/return-of-the-mcretro/: McRetro returns with a new home at McRetro.net, a Raspberry Pi 2 serving pages at near dial-up speeds and a huge backlog of videos. Smoke in the intro! 🌐
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-programming-the-pic1: The PIC18F2550 for my PICkit 2 clone programs successfully with the GQ-4X. Now I just need the missing parts before the Lunchbeat can join the fun. 💾
/baldwin-5917-steam-locomotive/: Baldwin 5917 is a magnificent 1952 steam locomotive that spent decades hauling NSW freight. No microprocessors, just a rather wonderful mountain of machinery. 🚂
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-update-part-3/: The PICkit 2 clone is recognised and the Lunchbeat is taking shape, but resistors, headers and a few missing parts keep both projects unfinished. 🔧
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-leds-part-4/: LEDs finally light up on the PICkit 2 and Lunchbeat boards. One wrong transistor and retina-burning blue LEDs keep the soldering adventure going. 💡
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-programming-101-part: The Lunchbeat's ATmega328P is detected through a PICkit 2 with PK2AVRISP, but programming still refuses to cooperate. Buttons, resets and firmware mysteries. 💻
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-programming-102-part: Mac OS X 10.8, AVRDUDE and the PICkit 2 finally communicate with the Lunchbeat ATmega328P. The trick involves the right programmer setting. 💾
/new-blog-ready-for-action-dropplets/: WordPress feels too heavy for a Raspberry Pi, so Dropplets and Markdown get a trial run. The next challenge is importing years of old blog posts. 🌐
/blog-resurrection/: Dropplets doesn't last long. FlatPress takes over the Raspberry Pi 2 blog, with working search, old posts to import and another mountain of fiddling. 🌐
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-sound-demo-int-clock: The Lunchbeat makes gloriously peculiar noises using its internal clock. Laser beams meet Geiger counters while the external crystal waits its turn. 🎵
/psio-for-sony-playstation-nearing-compl: PSIO's 2015 progress bar reaches 98%, with the old prototype returned to its developers. Metal Gear Solid footage reminds us how far it came. 🎮
/psio-for-even-closer-to-nearing-complet: PSIO edges closer to its first pre-orders in November 2015. Another little progress update while we wait to see the finished PlayStation hardware. 🎮
/psio-for-sony-playstation-reaches-100-p: PSIO's progress bar finally reaches 100% in November 2015, with the first 50 pre-orders expected soon. A milestone, not a claim about today's availability. 🎮
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-sound-demo-ext-clock: Correcting the ATmega328P fuses lets the Lunchbeat use its external 16 MHz crystal. The music sounds much better, even if the power switch still needs work. 🎵
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-1/: Fallout 4 streaming begins on PS4, but a roughly 1 Mbps ADSL upload restricts the video to 360p. Australian internet, you've done it again. 🎮
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-2/: Fallout 4 live stream day two brings more wasteland adventures, Sony and YouTube, plus a Sydney day so hot even lunch and dinner join in. ☀️
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-3/: Day three of Fallout 4 introduces Preston Garvey, the Minutemen and that first glorious Fusion Core. Power armour time! 🎮
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-4/: Fallout 4 day four visits Tenpines Bluff in glorious 360p, with skill points to assign and some questionable wasteland commentary. 🎮
/lunchbeat-pickit-2-resistor-upgrade-par: The Lunchbeat's eye-searing LEDs get bigger resistors and a new red-and-orange colour scheme. A dodgy audio cable provides one final fake failure. 🎵
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-5/: Fallout 4 day five clears the Corvega factory, collects far too much loot and loses the commentary audio. 360p and 900-plus pounds of regret! 🎮
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-6/: The Minutemen finally storm the Castle in Fallout 4 live stream day six. Reclaiming a fortress from monsters seems like a reasonable afternoon. 🎮
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-7/: Fallout 4 day seven means settlement building, shooting ghouls and gradually turning the wasteland into something resembling civilisation. 🎮
/far-cry-4-ps4-live-stream-day-2/: Far Cry 4 live stream day two returns to Kyrat, Pagan Min and the rather complicated question of what to do with my in-game mother's ashes. 🎮
/fallout-4-ps4-live-stream-day-8/: Fallout 4 day eight finally reaches 720p streaming! Now we can build towns and talk nonsense in high definition. The gameplay remains wonderfully dubious. 🎮
/sega-mega-drive-model-1-va4-pal-modific: Sega's 1995 service bulletin inspires a clock-signal modification to a PAL Mega Drive VA4. Mega-CD video looks stable, but the 32X still needs testing. 🔧

/sega-mega-cd-region-free-bios-programmi: A region-free Mega-CD BIOS finally boots after byte-swapping mistakes and a troublesome programmer jumper. At least some old fuses get a proper replacement. 💾

/f-15-strike-eagle-nes-review/: F-15 Strike Eagle on NES gets a review measured in eagles, including one upside-down eagle for terrible music. Final result: about 4.4 eagles. ✈️
/kirbys-adventure-nes-review/: Kirby's Adventure makes the NES look wonderful, from colourful graphics to fantastic music. Even my button confusion can't stop it earning an 8.7. 🌟
/lunatic-dawn-nec-pc-fx-review/: Lunatic Dawn has lovely animated sequences on the NEC PC-FX, but baffling Japanese menus and clunky combat earn it a mighty 1.8 McRetro units. 🎮
/mega-man-4-nes-review/: Mega Man 4 brings beautiful NES graphics and cracking music, especially Skull Man's stage. The difficulty is less charming, but it still scores 6.3. 🎮

/angry-birds-on-ipad-top-220-ranking/: An old Angry Birds iPad ranking puts me among the top 220 players. No gameplay footage, but Pepper the sausage dog makes a welcome blooper appearance. 🐶
/minecraft-villagers-in-moshpit-madness/: Minecraft villagers keep asking for emeralds, so I respond by flooding the town and adding lava. Entirely reasonable PS4 gaming behaviour, surely. 🔥

/apple-imac-21-5-inch-mid-2011-hard-driv: A charity's Mid 2011 iMac gets its Seagate hard drive replaced with a 2.5-inch disk, Icy Dock adapter and OWC fan-sensor cable. Plenty of screws! 🍎
/setting-up-sgdk-environment-variables/: Getting the Sega Genesis Development Kit ready on Windows means GDK, GDK_WIN and a PATH entry. Then comes the harder part: actually writing a game. 💻

/mayumi-4-pic12c508a-scph-7502-pu-22/: Another Mayumi 4 wiring reference, this time a PIC12C508A in a PlayStation SCPH-7502 PU-22. Eight points and reset-selectable modes, not universal wiring. 🔧
/cloudflare-cdn/: Cloudflare comes to the rescue of a Raspberry Pi website with a dreadful upload connection. Caching and proxying sound lovely; data harvesting, less so. 🌐
/creating-a-sony-playstation-modchip/: Making PlayStation modchips with Mayumi 4 and MultiMode3 means wrestling PICs, programmer errors and code-protected readbacks. The MiniPro gets a turn. 💾
/circuit-bending-a-sega-mega-drive-2/: A Mega Drive 2 circuit-bending diagram promises glorious VRAM glitches. The catch? There are more power pins than I first thought. Check the datasheet! ⚠️
/canon-760d-and-psio-update/: The Canon EOS 760D arrives to film tiny solder joints, while PSIO pre-orders are supposedly returning in March 2016. Also, two glorious Model M keyboards. 📷
/bugs-what-are-these-bugs/: Bagworms chew through a privacy hedge, but bifenthrin treatment has horrific consequences for nearby lizards. Never again. 🦎
/whats-next-you-decide-vote-1-2016/: A YouTube poll lets viewers choose my next project: Mega Drive region mod, SNES TSOP soldering or another batch of rather ridiculous game reviews. 🎮
/cloning-compactflash-cards-with-hdd-raw: Windows XP and HDD Raw Copy Tool make XTIDE CompactFlash images, but source read errors complicate the backup. Don't mix up source and destination! 💾
/sega-teradrive-model-3-power-supply-fai: My Sega TeraDrive Model 3 buzzes and refuses to POST. Swapping the power supply moves the fault, but doesn't identify the failed component. 🔧
/zeronet-bittorrent-and-another-darknet/: After getting a Tor onion mirror working, I explore ZeroNet, Namecoin and .bit domains on a Raspberry Pi. More decentralised experiments, more headaches. 🌐

/mayumi-4-pic12c508a-scph-5502-pu-18/: Mayumi 4 installation notes for a PlayStation SCPH-5502 PU-18 with PIC12C508A. Four reset-selectable modes, plus an oscillator-setting caveat. 💾
/photo-gallery-upgrade/: Google retires Picasa, so McRetro photos head towards Flickr and Facebook. By 2022 the Flickr experiment is over and a local gallery is the plan. 📸
/rubbish-collection-march-2016/: Two roadside PCs show up with no drives: a 3.2 GHz Pentium 4 with a broken USB port and a Duron 650 with bulging capacitors. Bargain! 🖥️
/introducing-the-gq-4x4-gq-4x-v4/: A replacement GQ-4X v4 joins the programmer collection, while suspiciously marked flash chips identify as ST M29F032D parts. More SNES cart tinkering awaits. 💾
/sega-teradrive-model-2-external-overvie: An external tour of the Sega TeraDrive Model 2 reveals dual floppy drives, PC/Mega Drive switching and an upgraded 2.5 MB of RAM. Lovely IBM-Sega oddity. 🖥️
/4th-year-anniversary-on-youtube/: Four years on YouTube brings 25,040 views and 78,046 minutes watched in the last month. That's a lot of people watching me break old computers. 🎉
/dimplex-dc10rc-review/: A Dimplex DC10RC struggles to cool a tiny room, with noisy fans and disappointing temperatures. Time for a more capable air conditioner. 🥵
/livestream-test-and-failure/: Another ambitious livestream ends in failure as the internet refuses even a reliable 240p broadcast. Happy fourth birthday, McRetro Show! 📺
/sega-teradrive-internal-overview/: Inside the Sega TeraDrive Model 2 and Model 3: integrated 286 and Mega Drive hardware, unusual wiring and the promise of CompactFlash storage. 🔧
/capturing-game-video/: ScreenFlow, OBS and Final Cut Pro X turn a half-hour video into giant ProRes files. The 115 GB export is impressive, but wildly unnecessary. 🎬
/unboxing-pier-solar-for-the-sega-dreamc: Pier Solar finally comes out of its collector's box, complete with lovely Dreamcast packaging. Small issue: I've already sold my Dreamcasts. 🎮
/doom-live-stream-test-360p-success/: Doom finally streams successfully in glorious 360p! Now if only Twitch and YouTube could agree on how to handle the background music. 🎮
/ibm-model-m-keyboard-frenzy-1x-multipli: One IBM Model M keyboard clicks away in glorious mechanical isolation. This is the calm before five and ten keyboards join the buckling-spring orchestra. ⌨️
/ibm-model-m-keyboard-frenzy-10x-multipl: Ten times the IBM Model M keyboard racket! The trilogy ends in magnificent clicky chaos, with an even more ridiculous 100x audio mix lurking elsewhere. ⌨️
/ibm-model-m-keyboard-frenzy-5x-multipli: Five IBM Model M keyboards click together for a wonderfully excessive soundtrack. One keyboard wasn't enough, and ten are coming next. ⌨️

/configuring-an-xtide-xt-cf-lite-for-the: Another XTIDE and XT-CF-Lite session puts CompactFlash storage into the Sega TeraDrive. Configuring the BIOS takes longer than anyone would like. 💾
/the-sega-dreamcast-hkt-0120-development: A Sega of America-tagged Dreamcast HKT-0120 Katana development box arrives. Before playing with it, there's an old SCSI hard drive to preserve. 🎮
/circuit-bending-vram-on-a-sega-mega-dri: Mega Drive 2 VRAM circuit bending can make spectacular glitches, but pins 11, 20, 30 and 40 are power or ground on this chip. Not targets! ⚠️
/sega-teradrive-model-3-faulty-power-sup: TeraDrive power-supply comparisons reveal a suspiciously low 12 V rail, but unloaded voltage readings aren't enough to diagnose the buzzing and boot failure. ⚡
/status-update-april-2016/: An April 2016 catch-up brings a used N64 power supply, a Dreamcast GD-Writer, a new oscilloscope and more TeraDrive work. Too many projects? Never! 🔧
/the-dimplex-dc15rcbw-reverse-cycle-air-: The larger Dimplex DC15RCBW actually cools a room to 20°C, unlike its disappointing little sibling. A portable air conditioner that works! 🌬️
/preparing-to-dump-the-sega-dreamcast-hk: A roadside Pentium 4, Adaptec SCSI card and 2 TB drive are pressed into service to preserve the Dreamcast HKT-0120 devkit hard disk. 💾
/dumping-the-sega-dreamcast-hkt-0120-dev: A 4.5 GB SCSI drive from a Sega Dreamcast Katana devkit gets tested with Linux tools and dd. Bad sectors make the preservation job interesting. 💾
GNU ddrescue takes over from ordinary disk-copy tools to preserve a failing Dreamcast HKT-0120 SCSI drive, including its historically interesting files. 💾
/emachines-e732-laptop-disassembly/: An eMachines E732 laptop comes apart for a hard-drive and Wi-Fi card swap. Debian and Windows disagree over the best adapter, naturally. 💻
/generating-vanity-onion-addresses-with-: Shallot on Ubuntu 16.04 generates fancy v2 Tor onion addresses, including one starting with cat. Historical only: v2 onion services are obsolete. 🐈
/fibre-to-the-node/: Fibre to the Node gives friends faster NBN, but the final stretch of ancient copper still bothers me. I'd rather have fibre all the way. 🌐
/limesurvey-and-rebuilding/: Helping with a PhD survey turns into a LimeSurvey version rollback, while WordPress and my onion mirror fall out again. Such a peaceful hobby. 🌐
/weight-for-it-ha/: A Withings graph shows the 2016 trend heading down, while the blog, shop and Raspberry Pi darknet mirror keep finding new ways to occupy my time. 📉
/status-update-june-2016/: June 2016 brings a catch-up on weight goals, university plans, a stalled Dreamcast devkit and a TeraDrive PSU. McRetro is still here! 🎮
/initial-tests-for-a-mcretronet-irc-serv: McRetroNet's InspIRCd server can finally host a conversation with myself. NickServ, ChanServ and the web client still need convincing. 💬
/new-weight-record-88kg/: A June 2016 milestone: 88 kg, my lowest recorded weight since tracking began in 2008. Plenty of graphs and a reminder that body-composition scales estimate. 📉
/ssl-tls-https-enabled-irc-server-runnin: The McRetroNet IRC server finally gets TLS via Let's Encrypt, while the website and a tiny WooCommerce shop also benefit from HTTPS. 🌐
/even-newer-weight-record/: More Withings graphs, more downward progress and another little 2016 checkpoint. The six-month chart makes the story easier to see. 📊
/ye-olde-mcretro-gaming-shoppe/: Ye Olde McRetro Gaming Shoppe gets ready for an August launch, starting with a few XenoGC chips and a WooCommerce store. OpenCart was too much. 🛒
/hello-my-ragtime-gal/: Tom Brier turns Sonic the Hedgehog tunes into magnificent ragtime piano. Casino Night Zone has never sounded so wonderfully old-fashioned. 🎹
/ebay-open-for-business/: McRetro's eBay venture begins with a ten-item seller limit, some odd household listings and plans for gaming stock. Also, Winamp 2.95 still plays! 🛍️
/sakura-wars-complete-song-box/: Eight discs of Sakura Wars songs were wonderful enough, then I discovered another eight-disc collection. Sixteen discs, and I've never played the games! 🎵
/blood-donation-july-2016/: A July 2016 blood donation leads to a frightening near-fainting spell afterwards. A reminder that donation aftercare matters, even when free snacks await. 🩸
/vegemite-australias-birthright/: Salt Reduced Vegemite adds vitamins B6 and B12 to Australia's favourite spread. More science on the label, but does it still taste like Vegemite? 🍞
/mcretro-gaming-shop-grand-opening/: McRetro's little gaming shop officially opens in July 2016, selling console modchips and accessories. Operators are standing by! Ribbon cut. 🎮
/my-weight-loss-rate-july-2016/: A July 2016 weight graph gets a ridiculously precise average, a blood-donation blip and some outrageous Vegemite maths. That's how science works, right? 📊
/fuse-replacement-on-the-super-nintendo-: Super Nintendo and Super Famicom PICO fuses raise a question: 125 V or 250 V? The actual circuit, interrupt rating and fuse speed matter. 🔧

/third-party-dreamcast-shell/: A translucent smokey-grey Dreamcast shell gets a tidy Dremel modification to accommodate the Broadband Adapter's ethernet socket. For once it works! 🎮

/80kg-weight-goal-achieved/: The 80 kg goal arrives in August 2016 after months of tracking, with celebratory graphs and a promise to get back to making YouTube videos. 🎉
/sega-teradrive-power-supply-problems/: A Sega TeraDrive power supply buzzes and stops the machine booting. Swapping with a known-good unit confirms the faulty module, not the exact component. ⚡
/programming-with-visual-studio-week-2/: Visual Basic week two brings FizzBuzz, Roman numerals and the mystery of banker's rounding. At least the code works, mostly! 💻
/youtube-is-back/: YouTube returns with a long personal update about old computers, frustrating programming lessons and a ridiculous pile of unfinished projects. 📺
/trout-is-salmon-salmon-is-life/: Salmon versus trout in a completely serious battle of fish with imaginary rifles. Also, actual FDA mercury figures. I vote salmon. 🐟

/programming-with-visual-studio-abandone: After two Visual Basic weeks, the programming course gets abandoned when its timing clashes with university plans. At least the windowed app works! 💻

/console-collection-overview-august-2016: August 2016 means downsizing to one console per generation, except the devkits and TeraDrives won't fit that plan. Fewer machines, somehow. 🎮

/ebay-you-glorious-beast/: Fifteen positive eBay ratings, a giant roll of bubble wrap and console auctions starting at 99 cents. If only the printer-ink buyer would pay. 📦

/composite-video-usb-capture-device/: A $25 USB composite capture dongle replaces filming CRTs with a camera, making Mega Drive glitch videos easier and less full of rolling bars. 📹

/75kg-weight-goal-achieved/: Another 2016 milestone: 75 kg on the scale, with Withings graphs showing a long downward trend. Now to slow things down and aim for maintenance. 📉

/jekyll-wordpress-import-from-xml-deleti: Importing 566 WordPress posts into Jekyll leaves a forest of unwanted metadata. OS X find, xargs and sed offer cleanup, with plenty of foot-gun potential. 💻
/markdown-and-apache/: Apache can serve Markdown files, but it won't magically turn them into HTML. Jekyll might help build a proper website for the old Tor mirror. 🌐
/isotretinoin-roaccutane-treatment-notes: Preparing for isotretinoin in 2016 means reading about side effects and getting lost in fish-oil spreadsheets. Personal research, not medical instructions. 🧪
/ceasing-minocycline-before-isotretinoin: Stopping minocycline before isotretinoin involves careful timing, prescribing advice and blood-donation rules. The skin improvements don't last long. 🩺
/sega-teradrive-retrofitting-a-mean-well: A Mean Well PT-65B fits inside a Sega TeraDrive PSU housing in another hobbyist's retrofit. Universal mains sounds handy, but this isn't my own install. ⚡
/blood-donation-and-weight-update-octobe: An October 2016 blood donation brings home a haul of free snacks, a new couch and yet another update on old videos and the Withings scale. 🍪
/the-good-old-switcheroo/: A cheap HP Stream 11 becomes my Linux escape plan, with a surprisingly nice keyboard, modest eMMC storage and plenty of compromises. 💻
/70kg-weight-goal-achieved/: An October 2016 milestone reaches 70 kg, with another set of Withings graphs. Now to see what the scale does next and eventually tackle those videos. 📉
/sega-saturn-gone-wild/: Eleven photographs catalogue Sega Saturn motherboard revisions, CD drives and power supplies from VA1 to VA13. Thanks, Zyrobs, for the detective work! 🎮
/what-helped-me-lose-weight-in-2016/: After a dramatic 2016 weight change, I document the foods, routines and energy calculations I used. A personal account, not a one-size-fits-all diet. 📝
/kdenlive-and-ubuntu-budgie-remix-16-10/: An AU$215 HP Stream 11 runs Ubuntu Budgie and even edits video in Kdenlive. The hardware struggles, but it's a fascinating Linux experiment. 🐧
/ghost-publishing-platform-on-the-raspbe: Ghost replaces WordPress for another Raspberry Pi website experiment. Node.js 4, Raspbian Jessie and lots of 2016 commands make this an archive, not a current guide. 🌐
/youtube-video-blitz/: A Christmas video-blitz plan involves 250 GB of unedited footage, Final Cut Pro X and terrible ADSL uploads. Perhaps the university connection can save me. 🎬
/65kg-weight-goal-achieved/: December 2016 brings another recorded weight milestone and a stack of graphs. The big question now is maintaining it, preferably with cake. 🎂
/cicadas-in-the-summertime/: Cicadas on a Sydney footpath get rescued and released, while university study and wonderfully fast campus uploads offer a rare dose of optimism. 🪲
/corydora-the-miniature-catfish-feeding-: SuperNick's Corydoras catfish emerge from their aquarium hiding places for an enthusiastic feeding frenzy. Tiny fish, impressive appetite! 🐟
/little-corella-at-the-local-nursery/: A Little Corella at a local nursery puts on three gloriously silly head-bobbing performances, in slow motion and at regular speed. What a show! 🦜
/the-first-day/: Two young green-cheeked conure siblings arrive at their new home on New Year's Day 2018. Names to come, crackers perhaps, mischief guaranteed. 🦜
/homework-time/: Homework on an iPad sounds simple until two green-cheeked conures decide apple is more interesting than Apple. Time for RoboCop instead! 🦜
/rumble-and-chase/: Pudge and Tillie wrestle on the rooftop, hunt peanuts and chase the cameraman towards the kitchen. Vegetable dinner can wait for bird business! 🦜
/tillie-plummets/: Tillie makes a sudden dramatic plummet during playtime, but manages to land directly on my exposed toes. A very ticklish bird rescue! 🦜
/economy-bathtub/: Tillie's first economical bath happens in the drinking-water bowl. Apparently the luxury bird bathtub is unavailable due to a serious millet blockage. 🛁
/snuggle-sleepers/: After a long day exploring their new home, Tillie and Pudge settle down together for a thoroughly adorable little conure snuggle session. 🦜
/heart-ball-of-love/: A heart-shaped rattle ball becomes the target of a devastating attack from a 23rd-century computer virus. Time-travelling bird warfare! 🦜
/play-preen-nap-repeat/: Play, preen, nap, repeat. Tillie and Pudge somehow fit the three most important parts of a conure's day into the morning before nine. 💤
/rattle-ball-attack/: Rattle balls are the natural enemies of wild conures, apparently. Tillie and Pudge prepare for battle in the safety of their new home. 🦜
/rattle-ball-wars/: Pudge and Tillie face the rattle-ball apocalypse, complete with time-travelling cyborgs and a suspiciously familiar Terminator plot. 🎬
/rope-climbing/: Tillie and Pudge scale their new rope from the bottom of the cage all the way to the top. Apparently bird gymnastics start at home. 🦜
/sprinkles-and-pudding/: Sprinkles and Pudding are actually Tillie and Pudge, the household's two mischievous green-cheeked conures. A formal introduction to upside-down birds! 🦜
/the-charity-ball/: Pudge and Tillie host the fanciest charity gala in Conureville. Formal feathers, absurd invitations and, naturally, a rattle ball. 🎩
/tunnel-ball/: An off-brand Christmas-hamper Pringles tube finds a second life as a tiny bird tunnel. Pudge and Tillie test their new escape route. 🦜
/whos-feeding-who/: Tillie and Pudge take turns feeding each other, then getting annoyed about it. Romance, drama and an unreasonable amount of conure behaviour! 🦜
/broken-links-fixed-every-last-one/: More than 400 broken McRetro image links get fixed after Picasa's demise. With university work finished, the video archive can finally get attention. 🌐

/sega-teradrive-240v-psu-upgrade/: A Mean Well RD-65A finally powers a Sega TeraDrive from 240 V without the original Japanese PSU. Actual game footage proves this retrofit runs. ⚡
/xo-7-in-1-gameshark-for-sega-saturn/: A rare XO 7-in-1 Sega Saturn GameShark offers RAM, Action Replay and save-memory modes. Its six switch positions are finally decoded. 🎮
/bifenthrin-insecticide-poisoning-in-liz: Bifenthrin treatment saves a hedge but leaves nearby lizards stumbling and dying. A distressing look at potential pyrethroid poisoning. 🦎
/sega-dreamcast-hardware-list/: A community-preserved list of Sega Dreamcast HKT and HIT part numbers covers Katana devkits, accessories, consoles and odd peripherals. Some entries remain uncertain. 🎮
/sprinkles-and-pudding-feast/: Sprinkles and Pudding, also known as Tillie and Pudge, investigate a feast of fruits, vegetables and pellets. Much of it ends up on me. 🦜
/super-famicom-and-pal-super-nintendo-po: PAL SNES and Japanese Super Famicom power plugs look alike, but the inner barrel and AC/DC requirements differ. Callipers to the rescue! 🔌
/have-a-drink-on-me/: A freshly cleaned cage and a bowl of water are irresistible to Tillie and Pudge. Drinking is optional; bird-related splashing is inevitable. 🦜
/play-fight/: Tillie and Pudge get into a friendly little conure wrestling match, and even the referee joins the action. So much for impartial officiating! 🦜
/stumblin-fumblin-and-snackin/: Ten seconds of Tillie and Pudge running, stumbling and stopping for snacks. Somehow these two pack a full adventure into a tiny video. 🦜
/when-we-were-young/: Tillie and Pudge enjoy their seeds before the arrival of a new baby conure named Chip. One last quiet moment before the household grows! 🦜
/chips-ride-home/: Baby Chip, a cinnamon green-cheeked conure, comes home in a tissue box. Tiny passenger, big personality, and an introduction to the bird family awaits. 🦜

/apple-chips/: New arrival Chip has only been home a day and already wants apple, sultanas and whatever else fits into that tiny beak. Corn can wait! 🦜
/baby-borb-infrared-and-lag-camera-tests: Baby Borb Chip gets an infrared-camera test and a separate lag test. Future bird livestreams deserve better picture quality than this! 📹

/baby-borb-camera-and-true-colour-tests/: More Baby Borb camera tests try to capture Chip in true colour, but interference keeps ruining the picture. The star is ready, at least. 🦜

/sony-playstation-psu-cracked-solder-joi: Cracked solder joints at an original PlayStation's figure-eight mains socket get repaired. A tidy PSU, but mains-voltage work demands care. ⚡
/super-nintendo-super-famicom-modes-of-f: CPU, PPU, VRAM or corroded traces? A collection of Nintendo Super System repair photos shows how different SNES hardware faults can look. 🔧
/chips-power-nap/: Baby Borb Chip curls up beside a sock friend after a lovely big feed. Being a tiny green-cheeked conure is exhausting work, apparently. 💤
/feeding-baby-borb/: Warm bird mush, two feeding videos and a tiny crop to fill. Baby Borb Chip knows exactly how to operate the human food dispenser. 🦜
/mcretro-gaming-ghouls/: McRetro Gaming resurfaces with forgotten footage and dreams of playing an unpatched Fallout 4, back when the ridiculous bugs were half the fun. 🎮
/the-darknet-tor-and-ssl/: Certbot brings HTTPS back to McRetro while the old RetroJunkie darknet mirror returns. A bit of Tor nostalgia, not a current v2 address. 🌐
/chips-first-bath/: Baby Borb Chip discovers the joys of a proper bath, with Tillie and Pudge supervising. Coordination needs work, but enthusiasm is unmatched! 🛁
/feeding-chip/: Baby Borb Chip's warm feeding session ends with a full crop, food everywhere and an urgent escape from the cleanup crew. Typical Chippy! 🦜
/air-conditioning-on-the-blink/: A Samsung air conditioner starts throwing ice at my head and growing frost on its cooling fins. Cleaning the filters seems like a sensible first move. ❄️
/nintendo-64-cartridge-slot-cleaning/: A Japanese Nintendo 64 with a filthy cartridge connector gets a clean. Two working consoles emerge from what was supposed to be a donor project. 🎮
/chip-on-your-shoulder/: There's a Chip on your shoulder! Our tiny Baby Borb discovers the joys of nesting in human hair and preparing for a career as a pirate. 🏴‍☠️
/chip-scritches/: A very little Chippy enjoys some luxurious head scritches after weeks of exploring, feeding and napping. No grand adventure needed today. 🦜
/learning-to-eat/: Baby Borb Chip graduates from mush towards seeds, peanuts and sultanas. Meanwhile Tillie appears to have rediscovered the drinking-water bath. 🦜
/bushfire-in-the-hunter/: A January 2017 bushfire near home in the Hunter brings helicopters water-bombing the flames. Thankfully the fire moves away from nearby houses. 🚁
/mcretro-late-night-gaming-sonic-1-1991-: Sonic the Hedgehog opens McRetro Late Night Gaming, minus the original music and with my own questionable replacement soundtrack. What could go wrong? 🎮
/sony-pvm-9044qm-overview-and-minor-repa: A Sony PVM-9044QM from the UK gets opened for an inspection after a rough journey. This tiny Trinitron has plenty of RGB potential. 📺
/the-flock-merges/: Chip begins meeting Pudge and Tillie after time apart. The newest Baby Borb joins the flock gradually, with plenty of little bird politics. 🦜
/blue-tongue-lizard-shenanigans/: A lucky blue-tongue lizard survives a close encounter with a lawnmower in the garden. One lizard and one mower, both still operational! 🦎
/exploring-and-eating/: Chip munches a seed-stick treat while Tillie and Pudge investigate a giant sunflower seed bell. Three busy birds, mountains of snacks. 🦜
/food-frenzy-with-chip/: Corn, apple, sultanas and seeds: Baby Borb Chip is growing up and discovering the world of proper food. Very important conure business! 🦜

/preening-party/: Tillie and Pudge give Baby Borb Chip a thorough preening session. Two videos of serious feather maintenance in pursuit of the cleanest little bird. 🦜
/baby-borb-chip-is-hatching-a-new-plan/: After being stepped on during the conure Stomp musical, Baby Borb Chip appears to be plotting revenge. Tillie and Pudge had better watch out! 🦜
/dancing-in-the-cage/: Chip, Tillie and Pudge get together for a conure dance party around the cage. Pellets after the performance, naturally. What a show! 🦜
/stomp-the-musical/: Tillie and Pudge turn the cage into a performance of Stomp, with Baby Borb Chip somehow ending up underfoot. The musical needs better stage management. 🦜
/mister-millet/: Tillie and Pudge get to work on a millet snack while Baby Borb Chip catches some rest in the background. A perfectly balanced bird schedule. 🦜
/play-time-for-crime-birds/: Tillie, Chip and Pudge plot to steal all the playground equipment. A classic bird-brained heist, with cooperation unlikely. 🦜
/the-breakout/: The crime-bird gang escapes the slammer after a failed playground heist. Pudge, Tillie and Chip are on the run, with imaginary disaster following behind. 🦜
/chirpy-chirps-live-stream-microphone-te: Three microphone tests try to get the conure livestream ready. Six hours of Tillie, Pudge and Chip without their chirps would be a tragedy! 🎤
/the-chirpy-chirps-live-stream/: Six hours of Tillie, Pudge and Chip on a live bird broadcast! Everything works except, rather unfortunately, the sound. Silent conures indeed. 📺
/destroyer-of-cameras/: The feathered Destroyer of Cameras declares all recording equipment must go. Chip, however, would rather concentrate on the bird seed. 🦜
/sharing-is-birding/: Tillie and Chip investigate a scrap of sultana-box packaging and argue over who gets it. Sharing is birding, but disagreement is inevitable! 🦜
/cute-little-tillie-noises/: Tillie makes a spectacular collection of little conure noises while trying to locate the birds on the television. We may need a translation dictionary. 🦜
/chip-enjoys-the-new-hut/: Chip inspects a lovely new fluffy hut. Is it for sleeping, hiding or plotting? The Baby Borb has important housing decisions ahead! 🦜
/chips-new-nest/: Chip discovers that a person's hair can double as a very convenient nest. Building materials wash themselves, which could be a design problem! 🦜
/set-preen-to-maximum/: Maximum preening mode engaged! Tillie, Pudge and Chip have important feather maintenance, and nobody should disturb the grooming department. 🦜
/troublemaker-tillie/: Tillie is making trouble again, with poor little Chip nearby to learn all the wrong lessons. So much attitude in one green bird! 🦜
/sleepy-time/: After a long day of playing and biting the people, little Chip is finally ready for sleep. Recharge now, cause more chaos tomorrow. 💤
/rumble-in-the-hut/: Tillie and Chip meet in the bird hut for another wrestling match. No rules, no referee and absolutely no sensible way of declaring a winner. 🦜
/tillie-zoom-chippy-boom/: Tillie zooms around for scritches while Chippy decides it's time for a fight. It's another day of speed, mischief and tiny conure drama! 🦜

/sega-dreamcast-controller-function-chec: A rare Sega Dreamcast Controller Function Checker hides a modified Mega Drive beneath its test boards. Almost 30 cm deep, it's too big for my display cabinet! 🎮

/nintendo-game-boy-vertical-line-repair/: Missing vertical lines on a classic Game Boy screen prompt a delicate ribbon-connection repair. Too much heat makes it worse before things improve. 🔧

/nokia-301-unboxing-and-my-last-attempt-: The Nokia 301 promises glorious battery life, but its spongy keys and awkward size lose out to Apple's ecosystem. Another smartphone escape thwarted. 📱
/sega-dreamcast-dev-kit-software-overvie: DA-Check and GDWorkshop finally communicate with a Dreamcast HKT-0120 devkit and GD writer. The recovered baseball game remains less cooperative. 🎮

/console-collection-resizing/: A dusty console collection shrinks towards mini Japanese releases and an arcade-style desktop cabinet. More space for hobbies, or just more keyboards? 🎮

/the-community-tank-adventures/: Todd, Slinky, Plankers, Whiskers and friends return for a tour of the Juwel Rio 125 community tank. Plenty of bubbles, hiding and aquarium chemistry. 🐟
